subject.title: feat: add Tenki Cloud sandbox backend plugin

question: Should Tenki Cloud be sponsored as an official externally distributed OpenClaw sandbox plugin, or should this vendor integration be maintained and published through ClawHub instead?
rationale: The public SDK seam already supports the backend and the merged MXC plugin is a precedent, but official package ownership, dependency approval, release responsibility, and the acceptable upstream reliability bar are product and security decisions.

options.title: Route it to ClawHub
options.body: Keep core generic and have the contributor publish a standalone Tenki plugin with install, configuration, permissions, update docs, and live smoke proof.

options.title: Sponsor an official package
options.body: Assign an owner to approve the dependency graph, define npm or bundled distribution, and require the security and live-reliability fixes before merge.

recommendation.title: Route it to ClawHub
recommendation.body: Keep core generic and have the contributor publish a standalone Tenki plugin with install, configuration, permissions, update docs, and live smoke proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged MXC sandbox plugin is the closest implementation and release-shape precedent.
